title: Wester Ross Salmon
about: Wester Ross Salmon has raised Atlantic salmon in the sea lochs of Scotland’s northwest Highlands since 1977, when Robin Bradley and Alan Mann founded the farm on the coast near Ullapool. It is one of the oldest salmon farms in Scotland, and until 2022 it was the last independently owned one. Robin’s son Gilpin ran the business until he retired in 2023.

The company calls its fish hand-reared, and it means it: the salmon are fed by hand from the pen-side, in small pens where nets are cleaned and fish are checked by people rather than machines. The farms sit in the tidal waters of Loch Kanaird, Loch Broom and Little Loch Broom, and the feed is made with natural astaxanthin and a high share of marine ingredients from fish trimmings. Wester Ross was one of the first Scottish salmon farms certified under the RSPCA welfare scheme.
Since 2022 the farm has belonged to Mowi Scotland, which has kept Wester Ross as its own small-scale brand. The salmon on our menu comes from these Highland lochs, about 3,100 miles from Eden.
